title: Kevin Warsh Says Fed Independence Is ‘Essential,’ But Limited
content: Kevin Warsh, a candidate to be the next Federal Reserve chair, said independence for the central bank is “essential.”

title: Millions Wiped Off UK Debt as 239-Year-Old Agency Buys Gilts
content: Millions of pounds will be wiped off the UK’s debt stockpile after a two-centuries-old government body invested a gift from private donors into a gilt maturing this year.

title: Traders Target 1,000% Return With Bet on Deeper BOE Rate Cuts
content: Some traders have placed wagers in the UK options market that could net a more than 1,000% return if the Bank of England ignores inflation at an eighteen month high and delivers more cuts this year than rates pricing suggests.

title: G-20 Nearing Deal on Communique, South Africa Finance Chief Says
content: South African Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana said the Group of 20 advanced economies are nearing a deal on a communiqué.

title: Fed Independence Is a ‘Myth,’ JPMorgan’s Benhamou Says
content: The idea that the Federal Reserve operates free from political pressures is a “myth” and US stocks are likely to keep soaring on bets that interest rate cuts are coming, according to JPMorgan Chase & Co.’s Ilan Benhamou.

title: EU Proposes Joint Borrowing to Finance €400 Billion Crisis Tool
content: The €400 billion ($463 billion) crisis tool proposed by the European Commission on Wednesday would be financed using joint borrowing, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Why Access to Running Water Is a Luxury in Wealthy US Cities
content: “Plumbing poverty” is surging in Houston, Phoenix, Portland, Oregon and other urban areas.

title: French Central Bank Chief Praises Plan to Fix ‘Very Excessive Deficit’
content: The French government’s contested plan to rein in the budget deficit goes in the right direction to tackle deep problems in public finances, the chief of the central bank said.

title: Currency Inflows to Russia Dwindle as Trade Shifts to Rubles
content: The flow of foreign currency into Russia is drying up as trade increasingly shifts to ruble payments, reflecting the impact of Western efforts to limit Russian cross-border transactions.

title: UK Jobs Hit from Reeves’ Budget Tax Hike Less Severe Than Feared
content: Chancellor of the Exchequer Rachel Reeves’ first budget appears to have cost fewer jobs than previously estimated, casting fresh doubt over the state of the British labor market after a string of data issues in recent years.

title: G-20 Finance Chiefs Confront Growth Hit From Trump’s Tariffs
content: South Africa called for greater cooperation among the Group of 20 advanced economies, as finance ministers and central bank governors gathered under the cloud of US President Donald Trump’s trade war.

title: Germany Rejects EU Plan for Beefed-Up €2 Trillion Budget
content: Germany has rejected the European Commission’s proposal for a significantly expanded €2 trillion ($2.3 trillion) budget, just hours after it was announced by Commission President Ursula von der Leyen in Brussels.

title: EU’s Proposed €2 Trillion Budget Rejected by Germany
content: Germany has rejected the European Commission’s €2 trillion ($2.3 trillion) budget proposal, hours after it was announced by European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen in Brussels.

title: UK Unemployment Increases to 4.7%, Highest Rate in Four Years
content: Fresh jobs data reinforced a picture of a weakening British labor market, with unemployment notching up to the highest level in four years.

title: Indonesia to Continue Talks on Jets, Minerals After Tariffs Deal
content: Indonesia will keep talking with the US on sectoral tariffs, jet purchases and critical minerals after securing a 19% baseline tariff rate on exports to the world’s largest economy, a government adviser said Thursday.

title: South Korean Minister Nominee Says US Deal Possible in Two Weeks
content: South Korea’s foreign minister nominee said he believes it may be possible to reach a trade deal with the US before the 25% across-the-board tariffs proposed by President Donald Trump take effect in August.

title: Swiss Exports to US Rebound With Trump Trade Deal in Limbo
content: Swiss exports to the US rebounded in June, evidence that trade between the two countries remains robust despite the pressure of ongoing tariff negotiations.

title: Waymo Expands in Austin After Tesla Launches Robotaxi Competitor
content: Waymo is more than doubling its service territory in Austin as the driverless taxi firm looks to fend off competition from Tesla Inc.

title: Tankmaker KNDS Eyes IPO, Stake Sale as Buyout Firms Circle
content: The German family shareholders of KNDS NV aim to reduce their ownership in the European tankmaker through a listing or stake sale to tap growing investor demand in defense companies, people with knowledge of the matter said.

title: Juul Gets FDA Authorization to Sell Its E-Cigarettes, Cartridges
content: Juul Labs Inc. received authorization from the Food and Drug Administration to sell its e-cigarettes in the US.

title: Wells Fargo Suspends China Travel After Banker Was Blocked From Leaving
content: Wells Fargo & Co. suspended travel to China after one of its bankers who works in trade financing was recently blocked from leaving the country.

title: Italy’s Market Authority Mulls Pausing UniCredit’s BPM Bid
content: Italy’s market regulator Consob is analyzing whether to suspend UniCredit SpA’s takeover bid for Banco BPM SpA, after an Italian court challenged some of the requirements imposed by the government on the deal.

title: Trump Says Coca-Cola Agrees to Use Cane Sugar for Coke in US
content: President Donald Trump said in a Truth Social post on Wednesday that Coca-Cola Co. has agreed to use cane sugar in Coke beverages sold in the US.

title: Abbott Drops on Outlook Cut, Sees $200 Million Tariff Impact
content: Abbott Laboratories shares sank after the company lowered the top end of its full-year guidance.

title: Elevance Falls to Four-Year Low as It Slashes Profit Outlook
content: Elevance Health Inc. slumped after it cut its profit guidance for the year on higher medical costs in Affordable Care Act plans and lagging reimbursement from Medicaid, the latest in a series of disappointments from health insurers in recent months.

title: United Air Sees Upside to Target After June Optimism Jolt
content: United Airlines Holdings Inc. said the second half of the year has become more predictable and suggested it may be able to beat its earnings targets after customers resumed booking flights following a tumultuous start to 2025.

title: Hong Kong’s $25 Billion Pile of Soured Debt Spurs Talks to Form ‘Bad Bank’
content: The pile of non-performing loans at Hong Kong lenders has grown so large that some in the industry have discussed the creation of a “bad bank” to soak up the financial hub’s soured debt.

title: Air India Junior Pilot Asked Captain Why He Turned Off Fuel Switches
content: A cockpit voice recording of doomed Air India Flight 171 indicates the younger co-pilot asked his more experienced colleague why he turned off the plane’s fuel-supply switches, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Uber Partnering With Lucid, Nuro to Launch Robotaxis in 2026
content: Uber Technologies Inc. is teaming up with electric vehicle maker Lucid Group Inc. and self-driving tech startup Nuro to launch a robotaxi fleet.

title: Tiffany Angers Rich Clients Who Wanted to Buy Rare Patek Watch
content: The jeweler bungled the release of a coveted Nautilus timepiece, alienating some customers and fracturing its relationship with Patek Philippe.

title: PepsiCo Beats Estimates Citing Strong International Growth
content: International growth helped buoy PepsiCo Inc.’s second quarter earnings, as the snacks and beverage giant said it plans to lean into higher-protein offerings and smaller portion sizes.

title: GE Aerospace Raises Full-Year Guidance on Aviation Rebound
content: General Electric Co. boosted its full-year financial guidance and topped Wall Street’s profit estimates for the second quarter after rebounding demand in the aviation market softened the impact of a global trade war.

title: Spain’s Curbs on BBVA’s Sabadell Bid Spark EU Backlash
content: European Union watchdogs have fired off a legal warning to the Spanish government for hindering BBVA SA’s €13 billion ($15.1 billion) bid for rival Banco Sabadell SA.

title: Swedbank Profit Beats on Lower Costs as Lending Income Drops
content: Swedbank AB reported second-quarter earnings that beat analysts estimates as lower costs offset slowing income from lending and fees and commissions.

title: UK Non-Dom Population Fell 0.5% in 2024 Tax Year, Data Show
content: The number of wealthy foreign residents in the UK claiming preferential tax treatment on their overseas income and gains fell 0.5% last year as policymakers moved to scrap the regime.

title: Novartis CFO Plans to Retire, Psoriasis Drug Disappoints

title: Ex-Lundin CEO Rockandel Joining Infor to Seize on Mining Deals
content: Peter Rockandel, former chief executive officer of Canadian metals producer Lundin Mining Corp., is planning to capitalize on the recent uptick in mining financing and deal flow as he returns to his banking roots.

title: Meta Trial on Privacy Scandal Features Tech, Politics A-List

title: Drugmakers to Sell Popular Blood Thinner Eliquis at 40% Discount
content: Drugmakers Pfizer Inc. and Bristol-Myers Squibb Co. will start selling their popular blood thinner Eliquis directly to patients at a cash-pay price of $346 a month.

title: BAE Says Drone-Fired Rocket Shows Path to Cheap Air Defense
